info.title: Lavbe administration API
info.description: Partially implemented administration API contract. /api/admin/v1 responses are no-store; no wildcard CORS. Cookie-authenticated mutations require Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Runner operations require independent short-lived scoped credentials. Record schemas are strict; arbitrary executable content is forbidden. Manifest digest covers sorted immutable versions only; buildId/createdAt are excluded envelope metadata. The complete manifest envelope is Ed25519 signed. Job creation returns a scoped runner credential once in X-Runner-Credential.

post.description: Login requires valid password and TOTP, same-origin Origin check and login rate limiting. Session cookie is Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite=Lax. No session CSRF token required before login.

wheel.title: Lavbe shared wheel configuration v1
wheel.description: Label and title maxLength are defensive code-point limits; enforce grapheme limits and semantic constraints separately. This is configuration, not session/report data.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON for the sorted immutable versions array selected by versionIds. Envelope metadata buildId and createdAt are excluded so the publisher can calculate this value before job creation.

artifactHash.description: SHA-256 of the deterministic immutable static artifact tree; promotion and deployment must use this exact value.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 of RFC 8785 canonical UTF-8 JSON for versions only; buildId and createdAt are envelope metadata and are excluded.

artifactHash.description: Null before the build completes; then the exact owner-approved artifact hash.
